title: Pirates Cove Watersports
specs: Dive sites include Molasses Reef, Elbow, French Reef, Christ of the Abyss, Spiegel Grove wreck
Explore Florida Keys National Marine Sanctuary and Pennekamp State Park reefs
Jet ski tours explore over 6 square miles of bayside waters with island views
Fishing charters target snook, redfish, tarpon, trout, bonefish, permit, pelagics, sharks
If over 12 months since last dive, dive guide required; over 24 months, refresher course required
Snorkelers must know how to swim
Jet ski drivers must be 14+ years old; renters 18+; minors cannot operate with minor passengers; boaters license required if born on or after Jan 1, 1987
First-time boaters not permitted to rent pontoons; competency test required if inexperienced

services.name: dive sites
services.desc: All minors must have waivers filled out by their parent or legal guardian. If parents will not be present, please make sure to have waivers filled out ahead of time. Friends and family cannot legally sign these waivers. Come join us diving or snorkeling on some of the most beautiful reefs located within the Florida Keys National Marine Sanctuary and Pennekamp State Park. We have many different reefs to explore, Molasses, Elbow, French Reef and the famous Christ of the Abyss on Dry Rocks. These protected areas offer an opportunity to see turtles, spotted eagle rays, moray eels and a variety of different fish. services.name: Fishing charter
services.desc: Located on the heart of the property at The Reef House Resort and Marina at MM103 Bayside, Get ready for fast action and unforgettable memories with the best Back Country & Flats Fishing captains, Captain Jeff specializes in exciting backcountry fishing for snook, redfish, tarpon, trout, bonefish, and permit, putting anglers of all ages right in the middle of the action. Whether it’s a kid’s first fish or a seasoned angler chasing a hard-fighting trophy, our trips are fun, safe, and driven by a true passion for fishing. Expect shallow-water strikes, big smiles, and a captain who fishes hard and loves what he does. Come fish with heart, hustle, and island attitude-Lyin’ Hawaiian Charter

blurb: Guests can dive or snorkel on coral reefs and wrecks, rent jet skis and boats to explore Florida Bay, and book fishing charters for backcountry, reef, offshore, shark, and night fishing. Snorkeling trips include gear and last about 3.5 hours. Scuba diving requires certification and offers daily trips to reefs and wrecks. Jet ski rentals and tours are available with safety briefings and age/license requirements.
